feat(pxlab_image): grayscale-first b/w & dither recipes, add rec709, honor Atkinson threshold

- Black-white and dither recipes now apply a grayscale pass before
  thresholding/dithering (dither previously ran on the raw R channel of
  color images, producing broken output). Add PxGrayMode.rec709
  (0.2125/0.7154/0.0721) to match MetaPrint's LuminanceThresholdShader.
- PxAtkinsonDither now honors its threshold field instead of a hardcoded
  128, matching MetaPrint's Atkinson(threshold: 125).
- Synced the same changes into the Rust pxlab-image crate and regenerated
  the Dart->Rust parity fixtures.
